name: Inter-Gaussian Context Model
definition: Predicts current Gaussian attributes using context from previously processed Gaussians. Splits the Gaussian set into sequential batches ($B1 \to B4$) to progressively enrich context.
summary: The Inter-Gaussian Context Model reduces entropy by predicting Gaussian attributes using context from previously processed sequential batches, distinguishing itself by explicitly structuring Gaussians into ordered groups rather than treating them as independent.
